random_forest_classifier.name: Random Forest Classifier
random_forest_classifier.description: An ensemble of decision trees that averages their predictions to reduce overfitting.
pros: Handles mixed numerical and categorical features
cons: Slow to predict on very large tree sets
random_forest_classifier.suitability: Highly suitable for general tabular datasets with complex non-linear relationships.

logistic_regression.name: Logistic Regression
logistic_regression.description: A linear model that estimates probabilities of classes using a logistic function.
cons: Assumes linear relationship between log-odds and features
Prone to underfitting on complex datasets
logistic_regression.suitability: Best for simple datasets where interpretability is a priority and relationships are mostly linear.

xgboost_classifier.name: XGBoost Classifier
xgboost_classifier.description: An optimized gradient boosted decision tree library designed to be highly efficient and flexible.
cons: Prone to overfitting on small datasets
Slower to train than linear models
xgboost_classifier.suitability: Recommended for larger datasets where predictive performance is the primary goal.

decision_tree_classifier.name: Decision Tree Classifier
decision_tree_classifier.description: A tree-structured model that splits data based on feature conditions.
cons: Unstable (small changes in data change the tree structure)
decision_tree_classifier.suitability: Good for simple classification tasks and as a baseline model.

random_forest_regressor.name: Random Forest Regressor
cons: Cannot extrapolate beyond the range of training data
random_forest_regressor.suitability: Excellent for non-linear regression problems on tabular datasets.

linear_regression.name: Linear Regression (OLS)
linear_regression.description: Models linear relationship between inputs and a continuous target.
linear_regression.suitability: Ideal as a baseline model and for simple linear datasets.

xgboost_regressor.name: XGBoost Regressor
xgboost_regressor.description: Gradient boosted trees configured for continuous target regression.
pros: Extremely high accuracy on tabular data
xgboost_regressor.suitability: Best for complex regression tasks on tabular data.
